description: Last login timestamp stored as text rather than a native datetime type. The column is complete with 0 missing values out of 30 records and contains 28 distinct non-null values, making it near-unique with 2 repeated timestamps. Observed values consistently use a 19-character datetime string format such as '2023-03-30 00:00:00', with values ranging from '2019-01-01 00:00:00' to '2024-05-12 00:00:00'.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert the column from string to a native datetime type; 100% of values are currently stored as text timestamps such as '2023-03-30 00:00:00' → datetime '2023-03-30 00:00:00'.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values follow the format: 4-digit year, 2-digit month, 2-digit day, space, 2-digit hour, colon, 2-digit minute, colon, 2-digit second — for example, '2023-03-30 00:00:00'.
